meta.title: ISO 9001 Certification | Outsourcing Group Padova
meta.description: Outsourcing Group SRL is UNI EN ISO 9001:2015 certified by IMQ for its Quality Management System, with international IQNet recognition.

hero.title: Our certifications
hero.description: The quality of our processes, verified and certified by an independent third party.

intro.paragraph1: Outsourcing Group SRL has achieved certification of its <bold>Quality Management System</bold> in compliance with the <bold>UNI EN ISO 9001:2015</bold> standard, issued by <bold>IMQ</bold>, one of the leading certification bodies in Europe.
intro.paragraph2: The certification (certificate no. 0536.2026) covers the provision of digital back office, contact center and customer support services, and is the guarantee — verified by an independent third party — of the reliability and quality of our work.
intro.paragraph3: Thanks to IMQ's membership in the international <bold>IQNet</bold> network, the certification is recognized internationally by the certification bodies belonging to the network.

iso.title: What being ISO 9001 certified means
iso.paragraph1: ISO 9001 is the international reference standard for Quality Management Systems. It defines the requirements an organization must meet to ensure structured, monitored processes oriented towards continuous improvement.
iso.paragraph2: For our clients it means relying on a partner that operates according to documented and periodically audited procedures: consistent service quality, traceability of activities and a concrete focus on customer satisfaction.
